services.name: Parasailing
services.desc: This Hawaiian Parasail experience is a fantastic option for those wishing to fly! About You will be able to utilize a harness method that entails a dry takeoff and landing directly from the boat and have the option of a teabag dip in the water or a completely dry flight, whichever suits your fancy. A maximum of 11-15 people are allowed on the boat. Participants who are 15 yrs old and under are required to have a Non-flying participant or Observer. A great way to enjoy the beauty of this tropical paradise from the sea and the air, experience an unforgettable parasail thrill ride, and fly high "Original Parasailing Company in all of Hawaii since 1977".

faq.a: It is dependent on weight & wind ratio. Most of the time it is possible. The weight cannot exceed 450 lbs. between the three riders. The captain has the final say.

faq.q: How long is the boat ride?
faq.a: You are out on the boat for nearly an hour. If you'll need a transportation, it's going to be 2 hours door to door duration.
Yes. We do provide complimentary round trip transportation to and from major hotels in Waikiki.

faq.q: How many participants can the boat take out at once?
faq.a: The boats are US Coast Guard Inspected for 12-15 riders and 2 crews.

quotes.text: The adventure of parasailing was an excellent experience. The crew showed their experience in handling all types of customers. Safety and fun were their priority. In addition, the crew was multilingual and showed great compassion to a customer from another group who became seasick during the short outing. In addition, if you're staying anywhere convenient to get to by walking

We were staying at Hilton Hawiian village so we just walked over to get our tickets my wife and I had never been parasailing before we had lots of fun all the employees were fantastic from the young lady at the ticket booth to the 2 very good guys on the boat they all knew what they were doing and made it a fun trip.

Terrific experience! It was my first time parasailing and I couldn’t have asked for a better time. A great and beautiful boat ride and an amazing time up in the air. I highly recommend this to anyone. They even come pick you up and return you to your hotel in a complimentary shuttle.

We had signed up for this para-sail through the hotel, where they picked us up and dropped us back which was very convenient. The actual para-sail was a great experience, and the staff was amazing in assuring (and calming) us for our first adventure of this type.

All staff had a great sense of humor and they even put us on an earlier boat when we arrived early. Would definitely recommend medicine for sea sickness! The views were beautiful and it was a great activity for our trip.
